problem: GitHub hosted runners are slow and expensive for CI.

founders.name: Surya Oruganti
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as the only active founder; no education or employers given.

competitors.name: GitHub-hosted runners
competitors.what: Default Actions runners that WarpBuild replaces

technical_complexity.rationale: VM orchestration and caching on cloud infrastructure with ARM and x86 support.

defensibility.rationale: Many drop-in runner vendors emerged; differentiation was price and speed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: GitHub remained the incumbent; several rival runner vendors appeared and BuildJet closed in 2026 per a guide.

market_need_then: Complaints about GitHub Actions cost and speed, per the company's launch claims.

rebrands.why: CB Insights says formerly Argonaut; reason unstated

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt listing; no merch found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name conveys speed and is memorable, but no evidence of community.

outcome_analysis: WarpBuild sells faster, cheaper GitHub Actions runners and now lists customers such as Sonar, Comcast, Raycast and Plex. Funding details are unclear, with only aggregator figures between $0.5M and $2M in 2021. It remains active and competes with many runner vendors.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights convertible note $0.5M 2021-08-30; Tamradar $2.0M seed; Remote Rocketship $1.5M; Extruct $1.5M led by Quiet Capital. Only aggregators so no round recorded. Competitor source date unknown, launch post undated. Confidence low.
